rationale: Both Viraj and Karan are at Meta and bring complementary perspectives on engineering and technical leadership—Viraj as a hands-on SWE with deep experience across multiple languages (JavaScript, Python, C++, Java, TypeScript) and robotics background, and Karan as a Technical Manager who can speak to scaling and organizational challenges. This pairing works well for exploring how individual contributor depth and management-level strategy intersect, whether for mentorship, collaborative problem-solving, or just insider perspective-sharing on Meta's technical culture.
intro_message: Viraj Patil, meet Karan Kalyan — you're both at Meta and have complementary roles (engineer and technical manager) that could make for a useful conversation about scaling technical work and leadership.
